title: Sweet Flatbread Toast
description: A simple and sweet breakfast or snack option, perfect for using up flatbread.
instructions: Preheat a toaster or toaster oven to 350°F (175°C).
Toast the flatbread until lightly browned.
Drizzle 1-2 tbsp of honey over the toasted flatbread.
Serve with a piece of toast on the side for dipping in the honey.
Optional: top with a sprinkle of cinnamon or a pinch of salt for added flavor.
